concerns.text: The plan references validation of MODIS covariates against NOAA GHCN stations (FR‑011) but provides no verified citation or automated download procedure for the GHCN dataset. In research.md the GHCN data are described as a manual download outside CI, which breaks the reproducibility and automation guarantees required by the constitution and FR‑011. A proper, reachable URL and inclusion in the “Verified Datasets” block (or an alternative fully automated source) are needed.
